title: Business English Conversation 8:  Getting Advice
content: 1. to be disorganized: to be messy and unorganized - Her desk is a disaster. She is very disorganized. - He can never find anything. He is disorganized. 2. to be flexible: to be able to change or adjust - My schedule is not flexible. It is not easy for me to change it. - My boss is flexible. He doesn't mind changing our plan or schedule a little bit. 3. to change one's mind: to decide to do something else - I was going to order a salad, but then I changed my mind and I got a hamburger. - She was going to invest in real estate, but then she changed her mind. She ended up investing in oil futures.
